correctness.rationale: For iid Bernoulli(p), 0<p<1, the transfer matrix for occurrences of 10 has trace 1 and determinant p(1-p)(1-z). Its n-step generating polynomial is R_n(u)=sum_{k=0}^{floor(n/2)}(-u)^k binom(n-k,k). The Chebyshev recurrence factors R_n(pq(1-z)) as a product of 1-4pq cos^2(jπ/(n+1))(1-z), showing a genuine independent-Bernoulli law with parameters in (0,1). Reversal gives 01. For 11 the leading masses are p^n, 2p^(n-1)q, and (n-2)p^(n-1)q+3p^(n-2)q² for n>=4, violating Newton a_(d-1)^2 >= (2d/(d-1))a_d a_(d-2). At n=3 the generating quadratic has discriminant -4p³q<0. Swapping 0 and 1 gives 00. At n=1 each count is zero and at n=2 each count Bernoulli; p=0,1 excluded from dichotomy.
